result.title: A "feature ODE" describing the learning behavior of shallow MLPs on simple functions
result.comment: Accepted as part of the HiLD workshop, ICML 2026
result.summary: We study the gradient flow training dynamics of two-layer multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on anisotropic Gaussian data. Even in this simple setting, solving the dynamics in full is notoriously difficult, so we try something different. We propose a "feature ODE" that might be intuitively expected to describe the learning dynamics of a shallow MLP. We find that MLPs trained to learn simple target functions (low-order Hermite polynomials and staircase functions) actually roughly follow the loss trajectories from this feature ODE. This agreement is a surprise because of the size of the simplification and the fact that it does not come from a rigorous chain of approximations. We discuss this surprise and speculate on its reasons and uses.

AI.brief_summary: 研究两层 MLP 在各向异性高斯数据上学习低阶 Hermite 多项式与阶梯函数时的梯度流训练动力学，提出一个「feature ODE」近似描述特征与损失的演化轨迹，并发现实际训练的损失曲线大致沿该 ODE 的轨迹走。
AI.relevance_reason: 用低维动力系统近似刻画特征表示随训练演化的轨迹，可能为理解 latent/循环推理中内部状态的训练动力学提供类比视角，但其简化假设能否迁移到 LVR 设置尚需核查。
